# Leaflet 1.9.4 (vendored)

Unmodified distribution files from <https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/>
(`leaflet.js`, `leaflet.css`, `images/`). Checked in so the app renders the map
without a CDN and keeps working if the CDN is unreachable.

- License: BSD-2-Clause — Copyright (c) 2010-2023, Volodymyr Agafonkin; 2010-2011, CloudMade
- Project: <https://leafletjs.com> · Source: <https://github.com/Leaflet/Leaflet>

Tile data is © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL); the app loads tiles from
`tile.openstreetmap.org` at runtime and attributes them in the map control.
